text.p: Belgian share analysts on average downgraded their forecasts for corporate profits in 1996 and 1997 by 6.9 percent and 2.8 percent respectively for a sample of 51 Belgian shares, French consultancy Associes en Finance said in its October report.
But for the earnings per share (EPS) of Bel-20 index stocks the 1996 outlook was revised up by 0.9 percent. The 1997 EPS outlook was revised down by 1.1 percent.
It said strong revisions to forecasts for four small-cap companies significantly affected the 1996 outlook for all 51 shares. Without the four, the downgrade amounted to 1.6 percent.
